audit_member_text: PARALLEL branches reference myid repeatedly beginning at L79, but neither the module's PARALLEL USE GLOBAL ONLY list at L8 nor the contained routine's list at L60 imports myid. The only possible source is unrestricted USE INPUT_READ at L63, making compilation depend on unintended re-export of myid by that module.

base_member_text: This file declares Module MOD_FOAM (L2) with the same module name as mod_foam.F; which of the two files is compiled into a build is decided by the Makefile, outside this file.

Cross-line: UFoam/VFoam are zero-initialized (L230-231), never updated (momentum block commented L315-336) and their ghost exchanges are commented out (L400-401), yet FOAM_FLUX_ICCE still upwinds on their sign (L419, L430, L443, L454). The active FOAM_FLUX instead uses the water velocity u,v (L477, L495). With UFoam identically zero the ICCE routine would always take the ELSE branch.

Cross-line: the EtaFoam update subtracts DT*MxFoam directly (L300-303) treating MxFoam as a divergence [m/s], while FOAM_FLUX_ICCE fills MxFoam as a face flux [m^2/s] (L420-434); the two flux routines are dimensionally incompatible with the same update line - only FOAM_FLUX (L466) is consistent with L300.

The nonbreaking-zone age handling (BurstTimeNonBreaking) present in mod_foam.F has no counterpart here; VFsurf in never-breaking cells keeps AGE_breaking's value (L261) with no special-case (L275-288).

Unused in this file: CdFoam/MinThick are read (L162-206) but their only consumers (drag update, L320-334) are commented out except MinThick in UPDATE_FOAM_MASK (L524-548); FxFoam/FyFoam/GxFoam/GyFoam, Usurf1/2, Vsurf1/2, VFsurf1/2, DepthFoam only allocated/zeroed; locals Uabs/Uadd/Vadd (L255), VxL/VxR/VyL/VyR/DelX/DelY of FOAM_FLUX (L468-470), left/right/top/bottom (L515).
OUT_FOAM/PLOT_INTV_FOAM/PLOT_COUNT_FOAM set up (L32, L75-90) but no output routine exists in this module.

audit_member_text: Name/interface conflict: MOD_FOAM defines host entity SMALL at L35, while contained INITIALIZATION_FOAM independently USE-associates GLOBAL::SMALL at L58. Unless these resolve to the same entity through nonstandard compiler behavior, the contained scope has two distinct accessible entities named SMALL and can fail compilation or bind ambiguously; the imported SMALL is not used in the routine.

FOAM_FLUX chooses one branch from the sign of the west x-face u(I,J) at L477, then uses that same branch to form both west and east contributions at L479-L487; the east face u(I+1,J) is never independently sign-tested. The analogous y calculation tests only v(I,J) at L495 while combining v(I,J) and v(I,J+1) at L497-L505. Converging/diverging cells with opposite face signs therefore use the wrong donor on one face.
